text:
R Data Visualization Workshop
    
      A self-study path through data wrangling, visualization and statistical analysis in R
    
    
      Dr. Mukul Maheshwari  ·  Dr. Rudresh Negi
       ·  Department of Community Medicine
    
  





  
  
    🗺️
    
      🟢 Open Access
      Dungeons & Dataframes
      Medical statistics in R as a game, from your first script to regression.
        Clear worlds, beat bosses, earn XP and grow your skill tree. Each region of the game
        matches one step of the study plan below, so you can read a step and then play it.
      
        Region 1 · Basics
        Region 2 · Moderate
        Region 3 · Regression
        Region 4 · Advanced (coming later)
      
    
    Start playing →
  


  
  
    Your self-study plan
    
      Four steps, in order. Each step is a track with its own day-by-day plan inside.
      Step 1 is open to everyone; the others need the workshop key from your session organiser.
